metadata.classification_rule: Only normalized AST body matches are confirmed_exact; all family, shape, name, wiring, and version matches are review candidates.

reviewed_findings.finding: InterviewLaunchRepository and InterviewSessionRepository each have multiple Protocol definitions under app.ports. Their method surfaces differ, so consolidation needs a contract migration rather than deletion.
reviewed_findings.next_task: P9-T02 reachability proof, then a dedicated port consolidation

reviewed_findings.finding: interview_plan_from_intent_draft and enforce_generated_interview_question_quality have exact copies in Domain and Runtime; Domain is the likely canonical owner.
reviewed_findings.next_task: replace Runtime copies with canonical imports after compatibility tests

reviewed_findings.finding: InterviewArtifactContext and EvidenceArtifactContext are exact dataclass copies and are candidates for one stable shared contract.
reviewed_findings.next_task: prove ownership and import direction before consolidation

reviewed_findings.finding: UUID, owner, canonical JSON/hash, file hash, safe-ref, and UTC helpers have exact repeated bodies across modules.
reviewed_findings.next_task: consolidate only where dependency direction remains valid

reviewed_findings.finding: Most repository/store families are one port with in-memory and durable adapter implementations; family-name similarity is expected, not duplication.
reviewed_findings.next_task: exclude from deletion unless reachability proves an adapter unused

reviewed_findings.finding: consume_round_review_event and consume_round_review_event_payload in app.runtime.composition inject dependencies and delegate to the consumer; their same-name matches are not duplicate evaluator implementations.
The v2 knowledge evaluation modules are imported by v3 and scripts, while durable_interview_state_v2 remains in production Runtime wiring.
reviewed_findings.next_task: P9-T03 must reach zero migration and runtime dependency before removal
